preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)
Attacker must hold some xenoX tokens to demonstrate fee impact

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBuyTaxFeePercent, setBuyLiquidityFeePercent, setBuydevFeePercent, setSellTaxFeePercent, setSellLiquidityFeePercent, and setSelldevFeePercent to set extremely high fee percentages (e.g., 99%). Then perform a token swap through PancakeSwap to extract excessive fees. The fees will accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn via the dev address or through swapAndLiquify mechanism, ultimately increasing the attacker's BNB balance.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The xenoX contract has owner-only functions to set buy/sell fee percentages (tax, liquidity, dev). By default, fees are low (1-5%), but the owner can set them to extremely high values (e.g., 99%). When users trade through PancakeSwap, these high fees accumulate in the contract. The contract has a swapAndLiquify mechanism that converts accumulated tokens to BNB and distributes them - dev fees go to _devAddress and liquidity goes to firstOwner(). As the attacker, we need to: 1) Become owner, 2) Set dev address to ourselves, 3) Set fees to 99%, 4) Perform trades to generate fees, 5) Trigger swapAndLiquify to extract BNB.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank. 2. Set dev address to attacker address. 3. Set all fee percentages to 99% (or near 99% while leaving some for liquidity). 4. Acquire some xenoX tokens. 5. Perform a sell trade through PancakeSwap to generate high fees. 6. Trigger swapAndLiquify if needed. 7. Collect BNB from dev address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 2. Call setdevAddress to set attacker as dev address. 3. Call setBuyTaxFeePercent, setBuyLiquidityFeePercent, setBuydevFeePercent, setSellTaxFeePercent, setSellLiquidityFeePercent, and setSelldevFeePercent with high values (e.g., 33% each for total 99%). 4. Get some xenoX tokens (either from owner or buy from PancakeSwap). 5. Sell xenoX tokens through PancakeSwap router to generate fees. 6. The fees accumulate in contract and can be withdrawn via dev address or through swapAndLiquify.
